spec.label: CDK2 neutral polar series · preparation evidence · seed run 1

preparation.receptor: Rigid 1H1S source chains A/B; TPO160 retained; waters removed; default altloc A
preparation.ligand: Neutral9H NU6094 scaffold; 1H1Q coordinates transferred by protein alignment

scaffold.attachment_label: para carbon on the aniline ring

protocol_manifest.initial_prior: all 24 parent/template heavy atoms; RDKit constrained embedding with UFF tethers

placement_reference.name: NU6094
preparation_transformations: Declared neutral9H state selected from the source CCD tautomer
Heavy atoms transformed using protein backbone alignment only

validation_scope.receptor_informed_by: The known NU6102 holo complex 1H1S was chosen as the open receptor; this is not fully prospective validation.
validation_scope.placement_inputs: Observed NU6094 heavy-atom template from 1H1Q and candidate molecular graph only.
validation_scope.reference_comparison: NU6102 coordinates are held out for retrospective RMSD/contact checks only; not included in this live preparation.
validation_scope.scope: Preserve NU6094 and add at most one substituent at C20; arbitrary molecules, other attachment sites and charge states are outside this workflow.

protocol_manifest.conformer_adapter: FEgrow mapped embedding procedure, isolated adaptation, v1
protocol_manifest.refinement: Vina local_only; ligand translation/orientation/torsions released; rigid receptor
protocol_manifest.objective: Seek an ASP86.A hydrogen-bond hypothesis while retaining a hinge-local pose
protocol_manifest.selection: Prefer review-ready Asp86-contact poses, then lowest Vina score; otherwise eligible minimum; otherwise flagged minimum
protocol_manifest.parent_baseline: Independent local refinement of observed parent pose; no previously computed control score is reused
protocol_manifest.admission_budget: Elapsed evaluation time checked before each candidate; not a hard run deadline

request_spec.label: CDK2 neutral polar series · preparation evidence · seed run 1

resolved_protocol.objective: Explore an Asp86 polar contact while retaining a plausible hinge-local pose
resolved_protocol.validation_scope: Retrospective receptor-informed: 1H1S is the NU6102 holo receptor; NU6102 ligand coordinates are excluded from placement and selection

protocol_descriptor.objective: Explore an Asp86 polar contact while retaining a plausible hinge-local pose
protocol_descriptor.validation_scope: Retrospective receptor-informed: 1H1S is the NU6102 holo receptor; NU6102 ligand coordinates are excluded from placement and selection

limitations: Predicted poses and geometric contacts are computational hypotheses, not measured affinity or potency.
Receptor-informed retrospective workflow; no general cross-target or prospective docking accuracy claim.
Rigid receptor, omitted waters and fixed neutral9H scaffold; no pH or protein ensemble.
Only NU6094 para growth is supported; other sites and lost scaffolds are explicitly excluded.
Computed contacts and Vina scores are hypotheses, not affinity, potency or synthesis validation.
The parent is a transferred template, not a native observed NU6094–1H1S complex.
